 Sleep Theory to perform in Manila for the first time in February 2027
 SPINS 
 2K 
 Estimated:   reading 
 Words by Hidzir Junaini 
 First published: 17 November 2026 
 Last updated: 17 November 2026 
 News 
 Gigs 
 Events 
 Sleep Theory are heading to Manila for their first-ever show in the Philippines.
 The Memphis rock quartet will perform at Skydome, SM North EDSA on 18 February 2027 as part of their headline tour. Presented by PULP Live World , the concert joins the band’s first run of shows across Australia and Asia.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by PULP Live World (@pulpliveworld) 
 The Manila stop also marks a homecoming for bassist Paolo Vergara , who moved from the Philippines to the United States with dreams of joining a band and touring the world. He returns alongside vocalist Cullen Moore , guitarist Daniel Pruitt , and drummer Benjamin Pruitt .
 Blending heavy guitar riffs with R&B vocals and pop hooks, Sleep Theory broke through with ‘Another Way’ before releasing their EP Paper Hearts and debut album Afterglow . Their catalogue also includes hits such as ‘Stuck in My Head’ , ‘Static’ , and ‘Words Are Worthless’ .
 The band have since taken their music to festivals including Download Festival, Pinkpop, Sick New World, and Sonic Temple, while sharing stages with Three Days Grace, Shinedown, Papa Roach, and Beartooth.
 Tickets go on sale on 28 November at 12 PM PHT through SM Tickets . VIP A tickets with a meet-and-greet are priced at ₱5,000, while VIP B costs ₱3,500 and General Admission costs ₱2,500. Ticketing charges apply.
